missions.name: Relay Breaker
missions.brief: Destroy three enemy relay towers and survive two assault waves. The last wave deploys a Warden siege unit.

missions.name: Iron Corridor
missions.brief: The district is barricaded. Break the relay network, manage core heat and destroy the siege unit.

missions.name: Warden Protocol
missions.brief: Cripple the final network. Four waves and a hardened Warden stand between your mech and extraction.
